description: MY EPK turns a conversation into a finished electronic press kit for DJs, producers, bands and vocalists. Tell ChatGPT who you are and MY EPK finds your Spotify, Apple Music, Mixcloud and Deezer profiles, imports your releases with artwork, and drafts your bio, stats and highlights from what you say. You get one link to open on your phone: check the page, add photos, sign in with Google and publish. Promoters and venues see a clean one-page kit at my-epk.com that loads in seconds and prints cleanly. Free to build and host; edit any time from the site.
